sentences.japanese: その裁きというのはこうである。光が世に来ているのに、人々は光よりやみを愛した。その行いが悪かったからである。
sentences.english: And this is the judgment, that the light is come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

sentences.japanese: そういう行為は世論の裁きを受けるだろう。
sentences.english: Such an act will be judged at the bar of public opinion.

sentences.japanese: 布を斜めに裁ちなさい。
sentences.english: Cut the cloth in a diagonal direction.

sentences.japanese: 布に応じて衣服を裁て。
sentences.english: Cut your coat according to your cloth.

sentences.japanese: 誰がこの事件を裁くのでしょうか。
sentences.english: Who is going to try this case?
